latest_release.body:
<!-- Release notes generated using configuration in .github/release.yml at v2.11.0 -->

## What's Changed

## Key Features

### General:
No longer mount HAMI-core to whole GPU allocation, metrics will be exported by NVML directly
Flexible-MIG
Support Cluster Autoscaler
Real-usage monitoring for Flexible-mig workloads

### Remote CUDA:
Allows running vllm on remote cuda

### Schedule:
PodGroup Support
New schedule policy: mutex
Schedule policy combinations
GPU/CPU Numa Align

### Devices:
Full AMD Support
Ascend 950 Support
libvnpu performance optimization



### ✨ Features Details
* ci: allow manual dispatch of the Trivy image scan by @moezdil in https://github.com/Project-HAMi/HAMi/pull/2768
* fix(monitor): replace MustNewConstMetric with safe helper and track InitContainers by @devGPP23 in https://github.com/Project-HAMi/HAMi/pull/2716
